```{r between-subjects design, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
data %>%
 #filter(!dominate == "dominate") %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "RU3gTWzp") %>% #we only have a single subject with less than a high school degee
  mutate(education_recode = fct_recode(education,
  HighSchool = "high school degree",
  Undergraduate = "bachelor",
  Postgraduate = "masters",
  Postgraduate = "Doctoral/Professional")) %>% 
  group_by(condition, education_recode) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
         mean = mean(Risk_Beta),
         sd = sd(Risk_Beta),
         se = sd / sqrt(n),
         ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) %>% na.omit() ->edu

data %>%
  #filter(!dominate == "dominate") %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
         mean = mean(Risk_Beta),
         sd = sd(Risk_Beta),
         se = sd / sqrt(n),
         ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) %>% na.omit() ->X
knitr::kable(X)
    

string <- "2b*3b"
n <- 191  

mu <- c(mean(X$mean),X$mean[4], edu$mean[11], 
        mean(X$mean),X$mean[6], edu$mean[17]) #pattern of means

sd <- mean(X$sd)

r <- 0.0
labelnames <- c("Domain", "Mood", "Executive function", 
                "Population", "Patients", "Public", "Experts") 

alpha_level = 0.05
design_result <- ANOVA_design(design = string,
                   n = n, 
                   mu = mu, 
                   sd = sd, 
                   labelnames = labelnames)
```

```{r exact, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
exact_result <- ANOVA_exact(design_result,
                            alpha_level = alpha_level,
                            verbose = FALSE)
knitr::kable(exact_result$main_results, caption = "Exact Results") %>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")

simulation_result <- ANOVA_power(design_result,
                             alpha_level = alpha_level,
                             verbose = FALSE,
                             emm = F,
                             contrast_type = "pairwise",
                             emm_p_adjust = "holm", #mutiple comparisons adjust
                             nsims = 1000, #set total number of simulations 
                             seed = 235353) #set seed for reproducibility

knitr::kable(simulation_result$main_results, caption = "Simulated Results") %>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
knitr::kable(simulation_result$pc_results, caption = "Pairwise comparisons Simulated Results") %>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
```



```{r power tables, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#calculate optimal n for 90% power given what we observed
plot_power(design_result, min_n = 40, max_n = 250,   desired_power = 80)
```

                    k = K,

f

mu <- mu * sd
mu

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
calc_f_d_eta <- function(mu, sd, variability){
  if (variability == "minimum") {
    k = length(mu)
    d <- (max(mu) - min(mu)) / sd
    f <- d * sqrt(1 / (2 * k))
    f2 <- f ^ 2
    ES <- f2 / (f2 + 1)
  }
  if (variability == "medium") {
    k = length(mu)
    d <- (max(mu) - min(mu)) / sd
    f <- (d / 2) * sqrt((k + 1) / (3 * (k - 1)))
    f2 <- f ^ 2
    ES <- f2 / (f2 + 1)
  }
  if (variability == "maximum") {
    k = length(mu)
    d <- (max(mu) - min(mu)) / sd
    f <- ifelse(k %% 2 == 0, .5 * d, d * (sqrt(k ^ 2 - 1) / (2 * k)))
    f2 <- f ^ 2
    ES <- f2 / (f2 + 1)
  }
  invisible(list(mu = mu,
                 sd = sd,
                 d = d,
                 f = f,
                 f2 = f2,
                 ES = ES))
}
res <- calc_f_d_eta(mu = mu, sd = sd, variability = "medium")
res$f
```
